message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and deploy DWC

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set up NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # The version from package.json is shown in the UI and decides whether the build ships
      # sourcemaps, so it has to be set before the build runs
      - name: Adjust version
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(echo "$VERSION" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
            npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "$VERSION"
          else
            echo "No version supplied, leaving package.json unchanged"
          fi
          echo "Deploying $(jq -r .version package.json)"

      - name: Build DWC
        run: npm run build

      # Besides the SD and SBC zips this picks up srcmaps.zip, which only stable
      # versions build - prerelease builds ship their maps inside the bundles
      - name: Arrange files
        run: |
          mkdir upload
          cp ./dist/DuetWebControl-*.zip ./upload/
          ls -l ./upload

      - name: Attach zips
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: zips
          path: ./upload/*.zip
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload files to testing directory
        uses: Creepios/sftp-action@v1.0.5
        with:
          host: pkg.duet3d.com
          port: 22
          username: pkg
          privateKey: ${{ secrets.PKG_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          localPath: ./upload
          remotePath: /var/www/reprapfirmware/testing/${{ github.ref_name }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow has a single build job with no explicit timeout, so a hung step (for example the install or the SFTP deploy) can consume the default 360-minute runner budget. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, supported by experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508, shows bounding jobs with a custom timeout reduces runaway consumption while preserving all required checks. Dependency caching already exists via setup-node cache: npm, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated (equivalent cache present), and there is no matrix, so fail-fast/cancel-stale do not apply. The one recorded successful run (~83 s) is far below a 30-minute bound, giving operational headroom while capping runaway runs. No steps, permissions, secrets, or network access are changed, and build/deploy coverage is preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}

name: Build and deploy DWC

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set up NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # The version from package.json is shown in the UI and decides whether the build ships
      # sourcemaps, so it has to be set before the build runs
      - name: Adjust version
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(echo "$VERSION" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
            npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "$VERSION"
          else
            echo "No version supplied, leaving package.json unchanged"
          fi
          echo "Deploying $(jq -r .version package.json)"

      - name: Build DWC
        run: npm run build

      # Besides the SD and SBC zips this picks up srcmaps.zip, which only stable
      # versions build - prerelease builds ship their maps inside the bundles
      - name: Arrange files
        run: |
          mkdir upload
          cp ./dist/DuetWebControl-*.zip ./upload/
          ls -l ./upload

      - name: Attach zips
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: zips
          path: ./upload/*.zip
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Upload files to testing directory
        uses: Creepios/sftp-action@v1.0.5
        with:
          host: pkg.duet3d.com
          port: 22
          username: pkg
          privateKey: ${{ secrets.PKG_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          localPath: ./upload
          remotePath: /var/www/reprapfirmware/testing/${{ github.ref_name }}
